summary: Analytics commands (balances, ledger, recurring, settle-up, spend) honor --csv/--plain via the hand-authored emitStructured helper instead of always emitting JSON.
reason: These commands hand-build structured output and called flags.printJSON directly, branching only JSON-vs-human-table, so --csv/--plain were silently ignored (piping `balances --csv` yielded JSON). rootFlags.emitStructured (defined in splitwise_output.go, a hand-authored file kept separate from any generated output helper) reuses printCSV for --csv and tab-separated printPlain for --plain, unwrapping a single wrapped-array envelope before tabulating, and falling back to JSON for multi-array envelopes (balances, ledger) where no single table applies. Generic get-* commands already honor --csv via the generated printOutputWithFlags.
validated_outcome: Live: `spend --csv` emits CSV, `spend --plain` tab-separated, `recurring --csv` unwraps its items envelope, `balances --csv` falls back to JSON (multi-array envelope); default piped output unchanged JSON.
